notes: Teacher objective L1 + w_ee*(1-EE) on prepared frames, detector off. `state` applies the loop's own 24 drawn aberration states and the illumination jitter (default 0.06) on each variant's bench; `optics_only` applies neither, so it isolates the static optics. Only defocus_m / zero_order_eta differ between variants -- geometry and detector fields are the fitted ones everywhere. peak_ratio is not reported; EE is not used to compare arms.
